properties.summary: Northern Precambrian basement complex across Oyo State (Saki, Iseyin, Sepeteri, Oyo). Thin saprolite soils and steeper inselberg slopes generate rapid overland runoff pulses following convective monsoon storms.
properties.management: Priority for agroforestry and contour soil-conservation strips along headwater tributaries to reduce sheet erosion and downstream sediment loading.

properties.summary: Western crystalline tributary catchment draining the Ofiki and Oyan rivers into the 400-million m3 Oyan Dam reservoir northwest of Abeokuta.
properties.management: Requires automated telemetric stage forecasting to synchronize Oyan Dam wet-season spillway releases with mainstem Ogun River flood peaks.

properties.summary: Confluence zone below the Oyan Dam spillway spanning Abeokuta, Papalanto, Ewekoro, and Ifo across the basement-sedimentary transition belt.
properties.management: Enforce 500m non-buildable fluvial setback corridors in Abeokuta and Ifo and halt alluvial sand mining along unstable braided channel banks.

properties.summary: Flat alluvial floodplain (below 12m elevation, mean slope 0.72 deg) spanning Mowe,ibafo, Kara, Isheri, Akute, and Ikorodu West. Acts as the hydraulic bottleneck where upstream flood waves pond.
properties.management: Halt unregulated wetland sand-filling in Isheri-North and preserve natural alluvial retention basins to absorb upstream flood volumes.

properties.summary: Freshwater-brackish discharge delta into the northwest Lagos Lagoon (Kosofe, Oworo, Ikorodu bay). Receives concentrated suspended sediment plumes (NDTI +0.164) and urban nutrient loads.
properties.management: Restore estuarine mangrove fringes and monitor seasonal turbidity spikes affecting lagoon artisanal fisheries and coastal water quality.
